name: Oval Projects Engineering Ltd
tagline: Rs ~110 Cr BSE-SME oil & gas infrastructure EPC and O&M contractor -- FY26 revenue +50%, PAT +59%, ROCE ~23%, a ~Rs 780 Cr order book (~5x sales) and a ~10x multiple -- but competitive-bid EPC is a low-moat, working-capital-heavy model with no listed track record
business_overview: Oval Projects Engineering (BSE-SME, IPO Aug-Sep 2025) executes EPC and O&M for the oil & gas sector -- upstream/midstream/downstream facility development: processing plants, pipeline laying, horizontal directional drilling, terminal stations, city-gas-distribution (CGD) work, and O&M of PNG networks -- plus some specialised infrastructure/civil projects.
fundamentals_narrative: On the surface this ticks a lot of boxes -- ~50% revenue growth, ~23% ROCE, a 5x order-book cover, and a cheap ~10x multiple. The offsetting reality is model quality: competitive-bid oil & gas EPC/O&M has no pricing power, is working-capital and mobilisation-cash-intensive, carries execution and client-concentration risk, and is exposed to the lumpiness of CGD and pipeline award cycles. It is a freshly listed BSE-SME with one year of public numbers and a low-quality (untrusted X) origination.

verdict_headline: A cheap, order-book-backed oil & gas EPC micro-cap with a strong first listed year -- return-magnitude label allowed on the valuation-box exception; conviction Low-Medium, unconfirmed
verdict_reasoning: Live-theme match: priority-2 'Oilfield services / drilling & exploration capex' (keywords EPC-adjacent oil & gas, pipeline, upstream/midstream/downstream) -- a re-ranking theme pending a formal Stage A4 bellwether read, so this is a theme-tagged pass, not a high-conviction theme play.
